candidate.answerReason: The added four gallons represent one-half minus one-third, or one-sixth, of the capacity. Six such portions hold 24 gallons.

methods.label: Find the added fraction
methods.explanation:
The four added gallons fill the difference between one-half and one-third of the tank. That fraction is
\[
\frac12-\frac13=\frac36-\frac26=\frac16.
\]
Thus one-sixth of the tank holds \(4\) gallons. A full tank contains six of these equal portions, so its capacity is
\[
6\cdot4=24\text{ gallons}.
\]
The answer is \(24\) gallons, choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
